description: A platform-level ceiling on how often ONE MOBILE NUMBER is contacted by the automation engine. Counts WhatsApp and voice together, over a rolling window. Email is not counted - a cap enforced on a number cannot have an address folded into it. Ships OFF.

fields.label: Cap how often one number is contacted
fields.description: Off by default. While off nothing is counted and nothing is refused.

fields.label: Most messages or calls to one number
fields.description: Between 1 and 20. WhatsApp and voice count together, because the cap is about how often a person is contacted, not about which channel did it.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: The window is ROLLING: the last N days, counted back from now. A calendar month would let a patient be contacted the maximum on the last day of one month and the maximum again on the first day of the next.

name: CRM Contact Cap Settings
